svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One blank: top 320 x 100 mm in the middle; front and back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 320 x 48.5 mm; ends 100 x 48.5 mm, each with an

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 mm flange; 12 mm tabs on the ends of the front and back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut with aviation snips; drill 3 mm relief holes where folds cross.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the front, back and ends down 90 degrees; fold the tabs round

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the corners and rivet each with two 3.2 mm steel rivets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold each end flange 90 degrees outward, flat with the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One 10 mm hole in each flange, 10 mm out from the end wall, central.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File every cut edge smooth; wear cut-resistant gloves.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: open bottom on the plate over the holders; two M4 knurled thumb

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws through the flanges into rivet nuts in the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it sits flat with no gap under any wall.
